questions.title: True or False
questions.text: Officer Chan trusting his AI glasses prediction without further evidence is an example of confirmation bias.
questions.explanation: Correct! Confirmation bias means that people judge base on their existing beliefs. Accepting an 80% AI score without checking other evidence is an example.is the tendency to favour

questions.title: True or False
questions.text: An expert officer with 20 years of experience is less likely to have confirmation bias than a new officer.
questions.explanation: Experience can actually reinforce confirmation bias — the more convinced someone is of their own judgement, the harder it is to accept contradictory information.
